create_conv1d_layer: create a Conv1D layer with specified output channels, kernel shape, and SAME padding
create_conv2d_layer: create a Conv2D layer with specified output channels, kernel shape, and VALID padding
create_conv3d_layer: create a Conv3D layer with specified output channels, kernel shape, and stride
create_group_conv1d: create a grouped Conv1D layer using feature_group_count to split input channels
create_conv_transpose_layer: create a ConvNDTranspose layer with custom output shape, stride, and padding mode
